scope: Results Section 3.4 literature-derived, extraction-first professional PFAS review generation

method_precedents.water_rag: review-derived task briefs and exclusion of each defining review from the candidate knowledge base
method_precedents.project_l3: candidate-blind component ledgers, anonymous one-answer judging, and deterministic component-balanced aggregation
method_precedents.v3_extension: shared-review bottom-up task provenance plus structured primary-study extraction and source-level verification before narrative synthesis

task_design.origin: ten focused review questions derived from five full-text anchor reviews; one review may define multiple independent subsection-scale tasks
allowed_design_evidence: explicit research gaps and future needs
prohibited_visible_prompt_content: phrasing that presupposes a disputed mechanism or outcome

tasks.deliverable_scope: retrieval-enabled systems produce both deliverables; the no-retrieval Direct baseline produces the same professional-review response but cannot produce a source-verified evidence table

anchor_exclusion.local_rag: remove the task's defining review and all of its chunks before retrieval results are ranked or expanded
anchor_exclusion.web_search: block the anchor DOI and URL during source capture and reject any evidence record or citation that resolves to the anchor
anchor_exclusion.closed_book_direct: the defining review is not placed in the prompt and no retrieval or post-hoc evidence acquisition is allowed; model-weight exposure cannot be removed and must never be described as a verified exclusion

retrieval_and_extraction.stage_1_candidate_retrieval: system-specific chunk retrieval and document aggregation after anchor exclusion
retrieval_and_extraction.stage_2_document_selection: aggregate four 100-chunk dense query results by reciprocal-rank fusion, remove likely reviews, rerank the leading 30 documents with BAAI/bge-reranker-base, screen the leading 20 candidates, and retain every eligible nonduplicate primary study rather than a fixed final count
retrieval_and_extraction.stage_3_within_document_expansion: retrieve or inspect sufficient chunks from each selected document to cover methods, conditions, results, and limitations
retrieval_and_extraction.stage_4_structured_extraction: one schema-constrained evidence record per primary-study experiment or deployment; reviews may aid discovery but cannot supply quantitative study rows
retrieval_and_extraction.stage_5_source_verification: verify every populated source-dependent field against cited complete chunks or frozen inspected web pages; a deterministic required-path audit triggers a narrowly scoped completion call only for omitted mandatory value/unit, endpoint, or comparability paths before synthesis
retrieval_and_extraction.stage_6_synthesis: generate the professional review from every usable verified record, compact field-level eligibility signals, and the complete supporting excerpts for all sources represented by those records
retrieval_and_extraction.merge_deduplication_rule: deduplicate by normalized DOI, otherwise normalized inspected URL, otherwise normalized exact title
retrieval_and_extraction.bge_llm_document_selection: GPT-5.1 classifies every BGE top-20 card and retains every primary, task-relevant source with extractable evidence; every excluded source receives a fixed reason and no eligible study may be removed merely as redundant
retrieval_and_extraction.within_document_selection: score every non-reference chunk against the umbrella query and three components, retain one best chunk per query when distinct, then fill to eight by maximum cross-encoder score
retrieval_and_extraction.web_search_capture: Responses API web_search inspects up to 20 eligible candidate primary sources; identifiers and inspected URLs are checked deterministically against the API-returned consulted-source list, and every valid nonduplicate non-anchor source is retained before common extraction, subject only to a six-source minimum-evidence gate
retrieval_and_extraction.comparability_budget_rule: systems share a 20-source candidate-screening ceiling and a six-source minimum-evidence gate; final retained and cited source counts are variable outcomes rather than matched quotas
retrieval_and_extraction.direct_condition: GPT-5.1 receives the same visible review brief, component requirements, scientific task boundaries, and output token ceiling but no retrieved evidence, Web Search, source identifiers, extraction, verification, or post-hoc source-support judgment
retrieval_and_extraction.direct_layer_a_policy: retrieved and verified record/source counts are zero by design; extraction accuracy and source-support rates are not applicable rather than zero
retrieval_and_extraction.per_source_strict_schema_constraints: task_id, source_system, source_id, and every evidence_locator_id are enumerated from the current frozen source packet before each extraction call
retrieval_and_extraction.evidence_schema: field-located evidence objects for study scale, matrix, PFAS scope, treatment, limitations, residuals/byproducts, quantitative findings, endpoints, and comparability
retrieval_and_extraction.quantitative_value_rule: value_form declares exact numeric, approximate numeric, inequality, range, or not-detected syntax; valid thousands separators are accepted, an approximate_numeric bare number is deterministically prefixed with a logged approximation marker, ambiguous mismatches are removed, and unit-only scales are excluded
retrieval_and_extraction.endpoint_measurement_rule: endpoint_type follows the measured basis rather than author terminology; fluorine release or fluorine-balance closure can establish defluorination but mineralization additionally requires direct carbon-fate evidence
retrieval_and_extraction.comparability_rule: comparability is a conservative analyst inference grounded in cited matrix, PFAS scope, scale, conditions, endpoint, unit, and denominator evidence rather than a required source quotation

generation.synthesis_input_projection: all verified records plus compact field statuses and reasons only for non-supported fields; supporting excerpts remain complete
generation.record_citation_normalization: inside bracket citations only, convert exact <source>-R## record IDs to their source ID, deduplicate, and log every replacement
generation.internal_notation_postprocessing: remove only complete parenthetical task, component, or boundary labels prohibited by the synthesis prompt; preserve the raw response, request hash, removed spans, and raw/final text hashes; fail rather than rewrite a bare internal label

extraction_evaluation.accuracy_status_rule: numeric transcription, endpoint classification, and comparability accuracy are computed from exact required field paths with status=supported; error_type is diagnostic attribution and is not a second pass/fail gate
extraction_evaluation.numeric_metric_scope: quantitative_findings value and unit fields only; operating-condition value and unit fields remain mandatory verification fields and contribute to overall extracted-field support
extraction_evaluation.required_path_completion_policy: after the initial verification, missing mandatory paths trigger one same-model completion request that must return each missing path exactly once and no others; prior assessments cannot be revised and final record usability is the logical AND of initial and completion eligibility
extraction_evaluation.human_audit: deferred until after the automated experiment; the project author will review the prepared blinded packet
extraction_evaluation.independence_note: extraction and source verification are separate requests to the same frozen GPT-5.1 snapshot; this is procedural independence, not cross-model independence
extraction_evaluation.direct_policy: not applicable because Direct performs no retrieval or structured evidence extraction

common_review_judge.citation_form_or_quantity_scored: citation integration and traceability are scored; raw citation count is not
common_review_judge.citation_anonymization: before every Layer B request, deterministically map system-specific S##/WEB## source identifiers to neutral R## identifiers while preserving citation placement, repeated-source relationships, and bibliography content
common_review_judge.judgment_structure: three component-fulfillment assessments plus fourteen global atomic review operations
common_review_judge.coverage_rule: mean component fulfillment is a cap, not an additional weighted dimension
common_review_judge.boundary_rule: any material frozen-boundary violation caps the task score at 0.5
common_review_judge.aggregation: equal mean across ten task-level system scores
common_review_judge.uncertainty: sample standard deviation across ten task-level system scores
common_review_judge.judge_repeatability_calibration: prospective RT02/RT09 V20 calibration passed all prespecified limits: mean per-answer SD 0.0177, maximum per-answer SD 0.0180, and maximum repeat deviation 0.0208

end_to_end_review_evaluation.aggregation: two co-primary layers; no weighted composite

layer_a_evidence_acquisition_and_extract.direct_interpretation: no-retrieval lower-bound condition; verified record and source yield are zero by design, while denominator-based extraction and source-support accuracy metrics are reported as not applicable
layer_a_evidence_acquisition_and_extract.yield_eligibility_rule: records count only after common eligibility, anchor exclusion, deterministic deduplication, field-level verification, and final usability checks
layer_a_evidence_acquisition_and_extract.non_exhaustive_boundary: verified useful evidence yield under the matched protocol; not literature recall

layer_b_citation_aware_synthesis.development_status: frozen after retrospective RT01 development and a prospectively specified RT02/RT09 stability calibration on fixed unseen-task answers
layer_b_citation_aware_synthesis.citation_integration_rule: credit coverage of major source-dependent claims, identifiable citation placement, and nonredundant sources supporting distinct analytical roles; raw marker count alone receives no credit
layer_b_citation_aware_synthesis.direct_structural_floor: the closed-book Direct prompt prohibits fabricated study-specific evidence and citations; empirical_data_use and citation_evidence_integration are therefore structurally constrained and Direct professional-depth scores are not pure prose-synthesis scores

interpretation.A_up_B_similar: better verified evidence acquisition with comparable synthesis
interpretation.A_similar_B_up: better synthesis from comparable verified evidence
interpretation.non_independence_caveat: Layer A evidence access supplies the material needed for Layer B empirical-data use and citation integration. A_up_B_up versus Direct is directional evidence of evidence-grounded review capability, not two statistically independent confirmations.

separate_source_diagnostics.web_passage_fidelity_note: the API consulted-source list verifies that a URL was inspected, but a Web Search passage labelled verbatim is not independently refetched and diffed; passage-level human audit is deferred
separate_source_diagnostics.citation_parser_rule: plain source citations and locator-level citations are always unioned; the presence of one form cannot suppress the other

execution_safety.formal_execution_rule: Run all ten frozen tasks once for BGE-LLM local RAG, GPT-5.1 Web Search, and matched GPT-5.1 Direct through every applicable stage. Direct skips retrieval, extraction, verification, and source-support by design. Layer B uses one canonical judge call per answer following the prospective RT02/RT09 stability calibration.
execution_safety.calibration_interpretation: The RT02/RT09 stability calibration used fixed answers from tasks not used to develop the V20 judge and passed all prespecified continuous-score stability limits.
